entities.name: Louis Albert Guislain Bacler d'Albe
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Louis Albert Guislain, baron Bacler d’Albe was a French artist, as well as the map-maker and closest strategic advisor of Napoleon from 1796 until 1814.
